etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English permision, permission, permissioun, permyssion, from Middle French permission, from Latin permissiō. Mostly replaced native English leave, from Old English lēaf (“permission”).

definitions.definition: authorisation; consent (especially formal consent from someone in authority)
(computing) Flags or access control lists pertaining to a file that dictate who can access it, and how.
(transitive) To grant or obtain authorization for.

quote.citation: 2003, Mary Ellen Lepionka, Writing and Developing Your College Textbook‎[1], page 190:
quote.text: Photographs also must be permissioned and credited, although a corpus of copyright-free images does exist online.
